I replied to Marcus in his DM, threaded on his message.

1. The Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk alerts ticket is #PD-4492. Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that evening, and the next morning's shift went through cleanly. I warned Marcus not to mix it up with #4419, which is a different gatehouse ticket.
2. Amendment No. 1 is 185 seats. Dana first posted 180 in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. Marcus is in that channel, and a seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so he can have it.

There is no Quarrendon contract file in the share, so I couldn't check 185 against the signed amendment. I told Marcus this and pointed him to June, who has the signed copy.
